High-resolution (600 dpi) scan of the printed Decipher card [[LIN-V8M (Elleyein-Veeateemm)]] (Premiere Limited, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Premiere/Premiere Dark/LIN-V8M.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8qrn2aDKgPeX1A4Sks3eTV5U0k/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>LIN-V8M.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,338,168 bytes, SHA-256 <code>9e6248cc3719b6c53c8fe0ce2abe25ae5cc308f7980b76e8641eef326c0b4d60</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the scan, 45.5, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.
